desc: Playing together, the only guest's link drops once its join is through and the relay forgets its ticket a moment (relay --kill and --forget 2 s, from the guest's "join: done": relay_go); the host, seeing it gone, starts a script battle (hei_03's Paragoombas, the auto battler) and fights it as its own. The guest comes back while that battle is under way: a late join needs a shared battle, so it waits in the field (never pulled into the battle, never fighting a copy alone; its where during the battle shows it in the field) and, once the host's battle ends, follows it again: both settled in the same place, the battle's progress the same (drift check), no merge (nm51f l51-057's outcome, locked in)

log_must: co-op: player 2 is back: seat 2 again
co-op: the host's game is gone: waiting
co-op: the host's game is back after
log_must_not: merge: joined the other game's progress
